What you need to design a chamber into a scheme

Dimensions, services, access route and lead time, plus the drawings and samples to put in front of your client. We work to your programme and through you, never around you.

Request the specification pack See the three chambers

Start with the dimensions

Three chambers, one seat to four. All three are modular, so they break down to pass a standard doorway and reassemble in the room. That usually removes the structural work a fixed vessel would need.

ModelSeatsL × W × HChamberAncillaryInstalled
Zeugma11344 × 1987 × 1858 mm890 kg270 kg1160 kg
Atlantis22151 × 2000 × 1859 mm1230 kg340 kg1570 kg
Mediterranean42926 × 1910 × 1860 mm2056 kg600 kg2656 kg

Weights are approximate and vary with specification and selected accessories. Larger and panoramic variants of each chamber are heavier, up to 3280 kg installed, and we will give you the exact figure for the model you are considering. The ancillary weight covers the compressor, concentrators and cooler, which do not have to sit in the same room as the chamber.

What sits alongside it

Every chamber runs with an air compressor, oxygen concentrators and a cooler. A buffer tank and air dryer are optional. The Zeugma takes one concentrator, the Atlantis two, the Mediterranean four, so plant space scales with capacity rather than staying fixed.

What we issue for your drawings

Point loads and floor loading, power, clearances, access route and plant requirements, set out for you and for your structural and M&E consultants. We would rather give you the real figures early than have you design around an assumption.

Something to design around, and something to show the client

The specification pack

Dimensions, weight, floor loading, power, clearances and access, in a form your consultants can work from directly.

3D renders in your room

The chamber placed in your scheme, so the client sees it in the space before committing to it.

Finish samples

Leather, material and RAL samples for the client presentation. Any RAL colour or automotive paint finish, matte, gloss or metallic.

The shell is finished to your scheme and the interior leather is specified separately, so the chamber can read as part of the room rather than as equipment that arrived in it.

We work through you, never around you

A chamber is the rare line on a schedule that can derail a project: heavy, serviced, imported, and it has to fit a real room and be running on time. That part is ours.

  • Your client stays your client. We do not go around you.
  • We work to your programme, so the chamber arrives when the project needs it.
  • One point of contact across specification, manufacturer, install and handover.
  • We handle specification, manufacture, shipping, install and handover, so there is no chain for you to manage.

From your drawing to a working install

  1. Specify to the space
